paras: Upgrade your Mercedes-AMG's rear braking performance with Dixcel brake pads, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel pads are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel brake pad compounds shown for the Mercedes-AMG A45S (W177), CLA45S (C118), A35 (W177), CLA35 (C118), GLA35 (H247), and GLA45 (H247) platforms. Multiple compound options are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the comparison chart on this product page to select the compound best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
